title: When the Group Chat Sings
author: Rosalind Ashgrove
blurb: Cyrus Ravensworth, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
